name: Mandalorian heavy blaster
description: An improvement by the Mandalorians upon standard heavy blaster pistol designs, the Mandalorian heavy blaster was a weapon in use during the latter years of the Old Sith Wars. The mercenary Calo Nord used a pair of the blasters, and examples of the weapon were available for purchase from Czerka merchant Greeta Holda and Mandalorian quartermaster Kex on the planet Tatooine and the moon of Dxun, respectively.
